entropy_per_charged_hadron.source: Hanus, Mazeliauskas, Reygers PRC 100 (2019) 064903 arXiv:1908.02792: dS/dy = (6.7 +/- 0.8) dN_ch/deta at chemical freeze-out [value from memory of the abstract; verify]

T_chem_MeV.source: Andronic, Braun-Munzinger, Redlich, Stachel Nature 561 (2018) 321 arXiv:1710.09425

tau_0_fm.source: Heinz & Snellings arXiv:1301.2826 (0.2-0.4); IP-Glasma+MUSIC tau_switch = 0.4 (arXiv:2005.14682); Bayesian tau_fs = 1.16 (Bernhard 2019)

fermi_momentum_GeV.source: Moniz et al. PRL 26 (1971) 445 (p_F ~ 260 MeV/c for heavy nuclei); rms per component p_F/sqrt(5)

decoupling_time_fm.source: ALICE PLB 696 (2011) 328 arXiv:1012.4035 (10-11 fm/c, 40% larger than RHIC)

eta_over_s.source: Schenke, Shen, Tribedy PRC 102 (2020) 044905; JETSCAPE 2021 ~0.1; KSS bound 0.08

kappa_v_over_eps._comment: Linear-response ratios kappa_n = v_n/eps_n derived from the Pb-Pb 5.02 TeV tables (flow.json / centrality_tables.json) at 20-30%: used for systems without measured flow

hadronic_phase_fm.source: ALICE PLB 802 (2020) 135225 arXiv:1910.14419: K*(892)0/K suppression implies 4-7 fm/c between chemical and kinetic freeze-out in central Pb-Pb; 4.5 chosen so the median emission time is close to the HBT decoupling time (10-11 fm/c, ALICE 1012.4035)
